name: Dweomer
description: Established to gather the arcane elite all under the watchful gaze of the Imperial Wizards Department, at its heart is the Torygg’s Magic Tower, the Empire’s sole arcane academy. Joining this academy requires exceptional talent and loyalty, verified by stringent background checks. Graced with grand mansions, lush gardens, and hovering crystals serving as arcane wards, floating lanterns illuminate its streets, which are adorned by stone golems disguised as statues. These golems answer only to Imperial Wizards, ensuring district security. Two forces control Dweomer: the Imperial Wizards, enforcers against illegal magic, and Archduke Omathyr, a check against excesses from the government. The Archduke is a virtuous and kind man. Loyal to the Emperor, he acts as his advisor, keeping him from losing his true purpose of protecting Tanares against the Ungods. He secretly employs adventurers to investigate corruption in the bureaucracy and the military, as well as to protect the innocent from unfair persecution.
